hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r .tool_input.command 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "^git commit"; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python -m pytest tests/ -x -q --ignore=tests/e2e/ 2>&1 | tail -5; fi'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r .tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // "" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "(rhodesli_ml|core)/.*\.py$"; then echo "REMINDER: Update ALGORITHMIC_DECISIONS.md if this changes ML behavior." >&2; fi'
osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code session completed" with title "Rhodesli"' 2>/dev/null; exit 0
